card.name: Phosphorylation word starts, plus a few others
card.fires_on: The first part of "phosphorylation" ("phosphory", "triphosph-ory") in antiviral interaction text. It also fires weakly on "water" after "with" and on "unchanged" in "as unchanged drug".

modes.label: Phosphorylation
modes.description: Partway through the word phosphorylation, especially for nucleoside antivirals.
modes.example: troviral Agents Lamivudine: Zalcitabine: Lamivudine and zalcitabine may inhibit the intracellular<< phosphory>>lation of one another.

modes.label: Swallowing with water
modes.description: The word water after "with" in instructions for taking tablets or capsules.
modes.example: 2.2 Administration Take tablets with<< water>> during meals.

modes.label: Excreted unchanged
modes.description: The word unchanged after "as" when describing drug excreted in urine.
modes.example: Fluconazole is cleared primarily by renal excretion as<< unchanged>> drug.
